description: Variation of condition 3 (approved plans) to allow substitution of drawings showing amended roof plans and elevations to the approved extension following permission 00530/69-71/P13 dated 09/05/2018 for erection of a two storey rear extension with a pitched roof to create 6 additional rooms and two kitchens to the existing house in multiple occupation together with a bin and cycle store area to the rear
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([L2399/32], [L2399/34], Received: 25/09/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the flank elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - The development shall not be occupied until the sections of footway to the front of the site, as shown on drawing number L2399/04 Rev. C, are reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.

Condition : 7 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 8 - Before the dwellings hereby approved are first occupied, the developer shall provide secure covered cycle parking stores in the location shown on the approved plans for not less than 20 bicycles. The approved facilities shall conform the Transport for London 'London Cycling Design Standards' in design and layout.
Condition : 9 - No waste and recycling bins shall be left outside the building at any time other than for collection.
